title: 26 November 1963: Live: Regal Cinema, Cambridge
content:
The 21st date of The Beatles’ 1963 Autumn Tour took place at the Regal Cinema in Cambridge.

This was The Beatles’ second and final appearance at the Regal. They had previously performed there on 19 March 1963.

As with all the other dates on the Autumn Tour, the group’s setlist contained 10 songs: ‘I Saw Her Standing There’, ‘From Me To You’, ‘All My Loving’, ‘You Really Got A Hold On Me’, ‘Roll Over Beethoven’, ‘Boys’, ‘Till There Was You’, ‘She Loves You’, ‘Money (That’s What I Want)’ and ‘Twist And Shout’.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024
